next_action: no QC action from the image evidence; the release decision stays with QC under its own tolerances (none are encoded here). Re-run when more sites of this batch are imaged: the minimum detectable change shrinks with n

descriptive_flags.note: batch-mean KPI: outlying site, not a localized defect (see per-site drift)

acquisition.note: sensitivity analysis: attenuation is the share by which the energy statistic drops under the stratified / adjusted view; it is not a share of the shift caused by the instrument

crack_frac.statement: Crack-like void area fraction is lower than the reference (robust shift 0.4 MAD) → less delamination-like void area in the section, direction only.
crack_frac.note: ±5-level threshold band not available for this KPI/these sites; statement printed ungated

pore_max_d.statement: Largest void (2-D equivalent diameter) is lower than the reference (robust shift 0.2 MAD) → a smaller largest void, direction only.
pore_max_d.note: ±5-level threshold band not available for this KPI/these sites; statement printed ungated

pore_frac.statement: Macro-pore area fraction is lower than the reference (robust shift 1.0 MAD) → less segmented 2-D void area; packing/wetting implications need independent validation, direction only.
pore_frac.note: ±5-level band half-width (median of 24 sites with a band, analysis_cache/acquisition_sites.csv (acquisition.threshold_bands; relative band × site fraction)) = 0.0163; |Δ median| = 0.0176 → physics reading printed

bright_frac.statement: Bright-phase (additive) area fraction is higher than the reference (robust shift 0.2 MAD) → more observed additive area; recipe, utilization and mechanical implications need validation, direction only.
bright_frac.note: ±5-level band half-width (median of 24 sites with a band, analysis_cache/acquisition_sites.csv (acquisition.threshold_bands; relative band × site fraction)) = 0.0032; |Δ median| = 0.0019 → physics reading withheld (shift inside the band)

bright_d50.statement: Bright-phase area-weighted D50 is higher than the reference (robust shift 1.3 MAD) → coarser additive sections; contact, chemistry and electrolyte access also affect later reaction/mechanics, direction only.
bright_d50.note: ±5-level threshold band not available for this KPI/these sites; statement printed ungated

physics.fraction_connected_note: No 2-D top-to-bottom macro-pore path on any of the 24 sites of this pair (fraction_connected = 0); the section tortuosity index is undefined and is not reported.
